_meta.warning: Every entry here is SECOND-HAND: produced by a delegated research agent that could not open a primary source, and read through legal commentary rather than the tebligs themselves. Article numbers, day counts, and every 'is gunu' (business day) versus 'gun' (calendar day) distinction must be confirmed by counsel or the compliance officer before any of this drives an alert. The loader marks all of them verified=false for exactly this reason.

obligations.title_tr: Sermaye yeterliligi tablolari ve yonetilen portfoy buyuklugu bildirimi
obligations.title_en: Capital adequacy tables and managed-portfolio size report
obligations.due_rule: within 5 business days of month end, by SPK-approved channel

obligations.title_tr: Yonetilen portfoy buyuklugune gore asgari ozsermaye yukumlulugu
obligations.title_en: Minimum equity requirement scaled to AUM (TRY 2m / 3m / 5m / 10m tiers)
obligations.due_rule: continuously satisfied; tested at each monthly capital adequacy filing

obligations.title_tr: Aranan sartlarin kaybedilmesi halinde Kurula bildirim
obligations.title_en: Notify SPK if any licensing/eligibility condition ceases to be met
obligations.due_rule: within 3 business days of the condition being lost

obligations.title_tr: Fon mudurunun ayrilmasi halinde yeni fon muduru atanmasi ve bildirimi
obligations.title_en: Appoint replacement fund manager and notify SPK on vacancy
obligations.due_rule: within 6 business days of the vacancy

obligations.title_tr: Portfoy yonetim sozlesmesi orneginin Kurula gonderilmesi
obligations.title_en: File executed portfolio management contract with SPK
obligations.due_rule: within 6 business days of signature

obligations.title_tr: Sirketin 3-6-9 aylik ara donem finansal tablo ve faaliyet raporlari
obligations.title_en: Management company 3/6/9-month interim financial statements and activity report
obligations.due_rule: per II-14.1 deadlines; disclosed via KAP, +15 days where the interim period is independently audited

obligations.title_tr: Sirketin yillik bagimsiz denetimden gecmis finansal tablolari
obligations.title_en: Management company annual audited financial statements
obligations.due_rule: within SPK II-14.1 deadlines after 31 December year end; disclosed via KAP

obligations.title_tr: Sirket finansal tablolarinda TMS 29 enflasyon muhasebesi uygulamasi
obligations.title_en: Apply TMS 29 hyperinflation restatement to the management company's own TFRS financial statements
obligations.due_rule: at each reporting date while Turkiye meets TMS 29 hyperinflation criteria; funds are exempt, the PYS is not

obligations.title_tr: Bilgi sistemleri bagimsiz denetimi (III-62.2)
obligations.title_en: Independent information systems audit
obligations.due_rule: every 2 years if equity exceeds TRY 5m; every 3 years if equity is TRY 5m or less

obligations.title_tr: Ic kontrol, risk yonetim sistemi, teftis birimi ve fon hizmet birimi kurulmasi
obligations.title_en: Internal control, risk management system, inspection unit and fund service unit
obligations.due_rule: continuous; small PYS may outsource inspection, internal control, research, risk management and IT to authorised institutions with SPK permission

obligations.title_tr: Supheli islem bildirimi (SIB)
obligations.title_en: Suspicious transaction report to MASAK
obligations.due_rule: within 10 business days of the suspicion arising; immediately where delay is prejudicial

obligations.title_tr: Uyum programi, uyum gorevlisi, risk yonetimi, egitim ve ic denetim
obligations.title_en: AML compliance programme: compliance officer, risk policy, training and internal audit
obligations.due_rule: programme maintained continuously; annual training and internal audit cycle

obligations.title_tr: Nitelikli yatirimci / talebe dayali profesyonel musteri statu tespiti ve belgelendirilmesi
obligations.title_en: Qualified investor / opt-up professional client eligibility test and evidencing
obligations.due_rule: before each participation-unit sale; since i-SPK.37.7 (18/12/2025, 65/2354) opt-up thresholds are TRY 10m financial assets and TRY 5m trading volume; pre-existing statuses grandfathered

obligations.title_tr: Kurul ucreti: fon toplam degerinin yuz binde besi
obligations.title_en: SPK fee of 0.005% of fund total value
obligations.due_rule: computed by the founder on the last business day of each calendar quarter, approved by the portfolio custodian, paid to the SPK account within the following 10 business days

obligations.title_tr: Fon yillik finansal raporu ve bagimsiz denetim raporu
obligations.title_en: Fund annual financial report with independent audit report
obligations.due_rule: filed with SPK within 60 days of accounting period end; publicly disclosed with the audit report within 90 days (GYF/GSYF, per II-14.2.c of 24/01/2025)

obligations.title_tr: Fon alti aylik ara donem finansal raporu
obligations.title_en: Fund six-month interim financial report
obligations.due_rule: six-month interim (30 June for calendar-year funds): filed with SPK within 30 days of period end; publicly disclosed within 45 days together with the limited review report where review applies

obligations.title_tr: Finansal raporlarin KAP'ta aciklanmasi
obligations.title_en: Publish fund financial reports on KAP
obligations.due_rule: by close of business on the 6th business day following the date the founder's board resolves to publicly disclose the reports

obligations.title_tr: GYF yil sonu gayrimenkul degerleme raporlari
obligations.title_en: GYF year-end real estate appraisals
obligations.due_rule: appraisal work completed by 31 December for any asset not appraised in the last 3 months of the accounting period; at most 5 business days between fieldwork end and report date; report delivered to the founder within 2 business days of the report date

obligations.title_tr: GYF alim, satim ve kiralama oncesi rayic deger tespiti
obligations.title_en: GYF appraisal before any purchase, sale or lease
obligations.due_rule: appraisal by an SPK-listed real estate appraisal firm must precede every portfolio purchase, sale and lease; transaction prices must reference the appraised value

obligations.title_tr: GSYF girisim sermayesi yatirimlarinin degerlemesi
obligations.title_en: GSYF valuation of venture capital investments
obligations.due_rule: valuation at each calendar year end; SPK-approved valuation firm report required every accounting period where the investment exceeds TRY 50m, every 2nd period for TRY 25-50m, every 3rd period below TRY 25m; a firm report dated within 3 months before period end may be used as the year-end value on an investment committee resolution

obligations.title_tr: Fon birim pay degerinin hesaplanmasi ve nitelikli yatirimcilara bildirilmesi
obligations.title_en: Calculate fund unit value and notify qualified investors
obligations.due_rule: at least once per accounting period; announcing a price more than once in an accounting period triggers limited independent review of the six-month interim financial statements

obligations.title_tr: Borsada islem goren GYF/GSYF katilma paylarinin kurucunun son acikladigi birim pay degeri ile degerlenmesi
obligations.title_en: Value exchange-traded GYF/GSYF units at the founder's last announced unit value
obligations.due_rule: mandatory from 31 July 2026 under SPK decision 23/07/2026 no. 45/1359: use the founder's last announced unit value, not the exchange price, at every valuation of a fund portfolio holding such units

obligations.title_tr: Portfoy sinirlamalarina uyumun portfoy saklayicisi tarafindan kontrolu
obligations.title_en: Portfolio custodian check of portfolio limit compliance
obligations.due_rule: checked against the fund total value table at accounting period end; on breach, SPK may grant up to 1 year from that period end to restore limits

obligations.title_tr: Katilma payi satisindan itibaren 1 yil icinde asgari fon portfoy degerine ulasilmasi
obligations.title_en: Reach minimum fund portfolio value within one year of first unit sale
obligations.due_rule: fund portfolio value must reach at least TRY 10,000,000 within one year of the start of participation-unit sales to qualified investors, invested within the teblig portfolio limits

obligations.title_tr: Ictuzuk / ihrac belgesi degisikliginin onceden bildirimi
obligations.title_en: Advance notice of fund rulebook or issuance document changes
obligations.due_rule: SPK approval first; changes capable of affecting investment decisions notified to unit holders at least 30 days before effect and announced on KAP; effect deferred to the first redemption date if a holder wishes to exit

obligations.title_tr: GYF tasinmaz kazanclarinin en az %50'sinin kar payi olarak dagitilmasi
obligations.title_en: Distribute at least 50% of GYF immovable-derived income as dividend
obligations.due_rule: by the end of the second month following the month in which the corporate tax return is due, i.e. 30 June for calendar-year funds; failure retroactively voids the KVK 5/1-d exemption for that year

obligations.title_tr: Fon kurumlar vergisi beyannamesi
obligations.title_en: Fund corporate tax return
obligations.due_rule: filed by 30 April for calendar-year taxpayers, even though portfolio management income is exempt under KVK 5/1-d

obligations.title_tr: Gecici vergi beyannamesi
obligations.title_en: Advance corporate tax return
obligations.due_rule: by the 17th of the second month following each quarter (17 Feb / 17 May / 17 Aug / 17 Nov, shifted for weekends)

obligations.title_tr: KVK 5/1 istisnalari icin YMM tasdik raporu
obligations.title_en: YMM certification report for corporate tax exemptions
obligations.due_rule: required from the 2025 accounting year where exemptions/deductions exceed TRY 1,000,000 thresholds, per YMM Genel Tebligi Seri No 49 of 30/12/2025

obligations.title_tr: Katilma payi stopaj rejiminin izlenmesi (2 yil elde tutma)
obligations.title_en: Monitor participation-unit withholding regime and the 2-year holding test
obligations.due_rule: 0% withholding on GSYF/GYF units held more than 2 years; 17.5% otherwise, per Presidential Decree 11107 of 26/03/2026 (RG 27/03/2026 no. 33206)
